source: FeedHero XML — Hobbycraft GB Google Shopping output feed (the feed wired in DEFAULT_FEEDS)
note: Primary g:product_type only — the FIRST value on each item. The repeated g:product_type values that follow it are the numbered keyword slots and are counted separately (keyword_saturation below), never as category paths; a slot is counted as a keyword only through labelguard.js kwValueKind, so the 32-character hex id FeedHero writes into slot 2 is never read as one. "products" counts distinct g:item_group_id; "skus" counts feed rows. This census is deliberately INDEPENDENT of the KWCal seed: the harness builds its index from the seed’s own paths and checks each one resolves here, so a mis-spelled path matches nothing real rather than matching itself.
